answer: Miscellaneous >> Dua (Supplications) Question ID: 16237 Country: Canada Title: Assalamualiakum, My wife is pregnent.. we want a baby boby so she recite the Surah Muhammad and Soray Yousaf any time of the day.. Is any specific time every day to recite these Surahs? Is this right if pregnant woman recite Surah Muhammad then Allah give baby boy? and if recite Surah Yousuf then Allah give handsome baby? Jazakallahhum Khair.. Question: Assalamualiakum, My wife is pregnent.. we want a baby boby so she recite the Surah Muhammad and Soray Yousaf any time of the day.. Is any specific time every day to recite these Surahs? Is this right if pregnant woman recite Surah Muhammad then Allah give baby boy? and if recite Surah Yousuf then Allah give handsome baby? Jazakallahhum Khair.. Answer ID: 16237 Posted on: Sep 1, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 1526/1227/L=1430) We could not find it anywhere that if a pregnant woman recites Surah Muhammad and Surah Yousaf she will be given beautiful baby. This may be practice of any saint, and for the above objective it can be recited with a hope that Allah will fulfil your wishes. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
